batches.note: The near shore: a rocky bank behind the jetty, turf on top, grass and stones.
The far shore: a rocky bank behind the jetty, turf on top, grass and stones.
The near jetty: a stone quay to the sea floor under a timber deck, railings with lanterns on their posts, and a gap in the north rail onto the gangway to the ferry's slip.
The ferry's slip: a ferry moored east-west in open water behind a pile boom, its tiller a lone post with a lantern on the north gunwale, and a railed landing from its stern to the jetty.
The far jetty: a stone quay to the sea floor under a timber deck, a slip with the ferry moored in it, a pile boom across the slip's mouth, railings with lanterns on their posts.
Out on the open sea: the ferry adrift where the camera starts, and the Thing standing on the sea floor.
